cruelty.linePrev: The captain of his ship, who matched you toe to tip
cruelty.lineNext: The following day, I shipped to sea with a privateer
stanza: One night I overheard the Prior exchanging words
With a penitent whaler from the sea
The captain of his ship, who matched you toe to tip
The following day, I shipped to sea with a privateer
And in the whistle of the wind I could almost hear...

cruelty.songTitle: I Don’t Believe in the Sun
cruelty.lineNext: The only sun I ever knew
stanza: So I don't believe in the sun
How could it shine down on everyone

cruelty.linePrev: And I will drink to your excellent health
cruelty.line: And your cruelty, will you have one on me?
cruelty.lineNext: Helpless as a child when you held me in your arms
stanza: Meanwhile, I will raise my own glass
To how you made me fast and expendable
And I will drink to your excellent health
And your cruelty, will you have one on me?
